seed_check: git grep across tracked artifacts and project sources found neither seed before registration
controls: 16 full starts per layout, teacher off, first episodes only, no scheduled or intermediate resets; 3000 control steps; native v15 body and frozen flight law
success: all five waypoints in order and at least 25 terminal accepted steps of foot-only support with positive upward impulse and low velocity; no physical failure and no simulator failure
prediction: at least 15 supported finishes out of 16 on each layout
failure_reporting: every attempted lane, first fatal contact or last sampled state if stalled, and exact box distance sampled at each accepted 20 ms control-step endpoint; perch excluded from obstacle clearance
development_results: 32/32 matched starts on former final-c and final-d, and 79/80 starts across five development courses with fresh seeds; one body-first perch contact
caveat: two unused nominal layouts and one unused seed per layout provide bounded generalization evidence, not a universal reliability guarantee
